terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

objectClass.notes: A fixed angle-steel stall: nothing opens, turns or swings, the bags hang from a fixed rail, nothing attaches, so one root pivot and zero sockets. It is the generic cart a level builder places in rows and dresses, so the draw-call ceiling is the design constraint. The generic sidewalk stall: a bare counter, a burner and an awning, dressed differently on every corner. Rusting galvanised angle, a scorched stainless counter, sun-faded red and cream stripes, bags of chilli and lime on the rail.

reasoning: ONE angle-frame merge -- four posts, eight rails, two decks, the bag rail, the twin burner with rings, the gas bottle, three bowl stacks and eight rust collars; ONE awning of two sloped cloth panels and two valances on a striped canvas; ONE bag component of four lathes with tinted contents: THREE draw calls of 4.

Three materials: galvanised steel (vertex colours: zinc, stainless decks, burner, gas bottle, bowls, rust), the striped awning cloth (a stripe canvas on white), and the translucent bags at opacity 0.55.
No repetition system: four bags differ in content and are one merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity at distance is the striped gable awning on four posts over a bare counter -- the registry notes say so -- and close up the hanging bags and the twin burner; the stripes are a canvas because a red band per stripe would be twelve boxes for no gain.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.40 x 2.10 x 1.00 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: A 1.56 x 0.72 angle frame 1.78 m tall with decks at 0.14 and 0.88; a gable awning 1.40 wide from eaves at 1.717 / 1.817 to a ridge at 2.017, resting on the post tops (v4: touching, not pierced) with 0.14 m valances; four bags hanging from a rail at 1.62 on the front; a twin burner on the counter, a gas bottle and bowls on the shelf.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x +-0.70 at the awning (v4, owner review 2026-09-03: the cloth overhangs the +-0.62 posts by 80 mm each side, declared width 1.28 -> 1.40; the proxy had read the awning as wide as the frame, 0.59 H against 0.596 H, and the owner wants more of the perimeter covered). y 0 to 2.017 at the ridge (declared 2.10), z -0.50..+0.50 at the awning, which IS the deep part at 0.49 H over a 0.65 m frame (declared 1.00). Corrected 1.80 x 0.90 -> 1.28 x 1.00 at model time on a near-CONSTANT +0.17 H width residual across all ten bands with the depth out by 0.03 -- a uniform offset in every band is an aspect ratio, not a shape. Rebuilt residual 0.018 width. Proxy occupancy: awning 0.86-0.98 H full width, bags 0.66-0.78 H at the ends, counter at 0.42 H, shelf at 0.06 H, posts at cols 4-8 and 69-73; w:h:d 1:1.430:0.727 with the awning overhang, and the proxy governs BOTH the stations and the plan: counter 0.88, shelf 0.14, rail 1.62, front eave 1.78 with the ridge set back to -0.12 and a short back fall to 1.88, which is the long front slope the plate shows rather than a symmetric gable. Bands 8-9 of the proxy read the awning 1.03 m deep and are NOT evidence: Meshy solidifies thin cloth into a wedge, which is exactly what a band 8 depth of 0.493 H under a band 9 of 0.405 describes.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: w:h:d 1:1.430:0.727, 3,856 triangles; stations as above. The plate is a three-quarter view from above; the declared envelope governs.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. featureReviews.evidence: Ten-band proxy comparison 0.018 width of H against 0.170 for the first build; envelope 1.40 x 2.017 x 1.003 m (v4: the awning widened 60 mm each side past the frame on the owner's review and the width re-declared 1.28 -> 1.40).
featureReviews.notes: THE WIDTH WAS A DECLARED ASPECT RATIO and the band table said so in a way no plate could: a near-CONSTANT +0.17 of H in every one of the ten bands while the depth was out by 0.03. A uniform offset in every band is an aspect, not a shape -- the same signature the roti griddle stand showed in this session. The proxy then gave a second finding for free: it reads 0.59 H at the frame bands and 0.596 H at the awning bands, so THE AWNING IS AS WIDE AS THE FRAME and does not overhang sideways, where this build ran the cloth 0.10 m proud of a frame already 0.32 m too wide. Bands 8-9 depth are NOT evidence and were not chased: reference depth 0.493 H at band 8 under 0.405 H at band 9 is a solid WEDGE, which is Meshy thickening thin cloth. v4 (owner review) overrides the as-wide-as-the-frame reading: the cloth now overhangs the posts by 80 mm each side so more of the perimeter is covered.

reviewHistory.summary: Blockout: three components at 3 draw calls of 4; frame, awning, bags.

Owner review (v4, 2026-09-03): "make the roof wider left/right; raise it a bit, the frame is sticking through -- touching but not going through". Awning 1.24 -> 1.40 wide (80 mm past each post line, width re-declared 1.40) and the whole cloth raised 22 mm (eaves 1.717 / 1.817, ridge 2.017). The v3 posts ran 10 mm into the slope and, a flat post top under a sloped sheet, poked their downhill corners 4.5 mm out through the 4 mm cloth; the post tops now sit 0.5-1 mm under the underside at that corner.

Owner review (v3, 2026-09-03): "lower the roof so it connects with the frame". The awning hung 85 mm above the front posts and 190 mm above the rear ones; the whole cloth dropped 0.085 (eaves 1.695 / 1.795, ridge 1.995), the front posts run 10 mm into the front slope, the rear posts lengthened to 1.90 into the back slope, and an eave rail was added along each post line under the cloth.
Plan corrected 1.80 x 0.90 -> 1.28 x 1.00 on a constant +0.17 H width residual across all ten bands; awning narrowed to the frame width and rebuilt as a long front slope. Residual 0.170 -> 0.018.

reviewHistory.summary: Material pass. Measured over a MATCHED region -- every foreground pixel in the bottom 45% of the silhouette -- the plate reads a median luma of 75 and the first build read 167: twice as bright as its own reference, and it rendered as a white shelving unit rather than a used galvanised stall. THAT IS NOT SHIPPABLE AS A NEUTRAL -- the turntable gate reads |luma - 58| <= 24 at saturation <= 0.16 as backdrop, so a near-neutral frame at a median of 78 would be punched through across its whole silhouette. The frame goes to scale 0.53 (median 111, and only 0.2% of the band inside the gate window) and takes the rest in CHROMA: #5f5246 at saturation 0.26 against #9a9d9e at 0.025, which is also truer to a plate whose zinc is described rusting at the joints and photographs grey-brown. The bag material was also missing vertexColors, so the chillies and limes inside the bags were authored, merged and then rendered in the material own pale #f0efe9 -- four white blobs where the plate has the produce showing through, which is the only reason the bags are on it.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.93. 1,216/4,000 triangles, 3/4 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 3/6 unique geometries, two 256 px canvases. Open frame: turntable with --allow-holes on the _holecc measurement.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three components, no repetition system: 3 of 4.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1,228 of 4,000: thirty boxes, seven cylinders, four lathes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Boxes for the frame, decks, burner and awning panels; cylinders for the bottle, bowls and burner rings; lathes for the bags.
No InstancedMesh: four bags differ in content. In a scene the HOST instances the stall.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. One 256 px rust canvas and one 256 px stripe canvas after construction, 0.5 MB.

risks.description: An open frame encloses background at every azimuth.
The awning eaves reach +-0.57 against the declared +-0.45.
risks.mitigation: The collider stays at the declared depth; the cloth overhang is what the plate shows.
